notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM, standard logical-time factories selected by the adapter, HLAinteger32BE, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and federate configuration. It observes HLAtimeManagerState around each standard time-advance request form and its Time Advance Grant; no provider-specific headers, names, registries, or internal APIs are used.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador federation lifecycle, standard-MIM subscription, five time-advance request services, and FederateAmbassador reflection, Flush Queue Grant, and Time Advance Grant callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: RTIambassador::createFederationExecutionWithMIM, RTIambassador::joinFederationExecution, RTIambassador::subscribeObjectClassAttributes, RTIambassador::timeAdvanceRequest, RTIambassador::timeAdvanceRequestAvailable, RTIambassador::nextMessageRequest, RTIambassador::nextMessageRequestAvailable, RTIambassador::flushQueueRequest, FederateAmbassador::reflectAttributeValues, FederateAmbassador::flushQueueGrant, FederateAmbassador::timeAdvanceGrant, HLAinteger32BE
